answer: A prism splits one beam into many colours; a sybil attacker tries the reverse, many fake identities from one box. Stop it with proof of network position: independent beacons across continents send latency challenges, and each agent replies form a unique timing signature, like an opal shifting colours, impossible from a single place. Clones behind one proxy share one signature and are flagged, and each detection sends a ripple through the network, raising audit rates nearby. Faking a position means renting spread-out infrastructure per fake identity, while honest agents pay only milliseconds.
